subject: settle drain unblocked: 857 overdue -> 0
body: Three defects kept the stale-settlement backfill from ever writing a row. (1) It ran after the free pass, which consumes the route's 300s maxDuration, so it never executed; moved to step 1. (2) persistInTx called $transaction through a detached reference, losing this -> Prisma 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _engineConfig)'. (3) pickSettlementEvent.create() hit pickId @unique (P2002) for any re-opened pick and rolled the transaction back; now an upsert that resets the row to PENDING for re-announcement. Verified live: the 19:20 CT cycle wrote 345 free-backfill events (lane had zero ever) and published PENDING went 857 overdue -> 86 total, 0 overdue >48h. 42 tests green (25 backfill, 17 route). Commits 9aaf7b9fd, 93beacc77, 787169ed0; production sha 787169ed0.
